explanation: The statement is the instance a ++ (b ++ c) ~ c ++ (b ++ a) for lists. I searched Lean core, Batteries and Mathlib for list-permutation lemmas about three-list append reversal. The closest are List.perm_append_comm and List.perm_append_comm_assoc (Init/Data/List/Perm.lean). Those give only l₁ ++ l₂ ~ l₂ ++ l₁ and l₁ ++ (l₂ ++ l₃) ~ l₂ ++ (l₁ ++ l₃). The library's proof composes three such steps, so it is not a one- or two-line instantiation of a single declaration. I found no single lemma that reverses a three-fold append up to permutation.
